messages:
Caroline L.: Quick update: we're starting a SOC 2 continuous audit pilot for Private/VPC customers next week. This is a small, instrumented cohort (10 customers) to validate automated evidence collection, attestation PDFs, and Console delivery. Please review the short checklist below and flag any blockers by EOD. :clipboard:

Infra-Bot: NOTICE: Pilot kickoff window scheduled 2067778000 -> 2067778123. Staging collectors are enabled. Internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/soc2-continuous-pilot

Samir K.: Which customers are in the cohort? CS needs to schedule prep calls and confirm consent docs.

Caroline L.: Cohort: acme-fin, midwest-health, cloudscribe + 7 others (private list in the pilot tracker). CS will run 1hr readiness calls; require signed NDA + data-mapping consent.

Ryan M. (Security): Important: collection uses delegated, short-lived read-only tokens; no customer key handover. For on-prem nodes, we require KMS attestations and agent heartbeat. Air-gapped installs will use offline evidence bundles.

Elena P.: Runtime/SRE note: we need to push a lightweight agent update (redwood-agent v2.14.0) on private nodes before enabling auto-collection. Target change window: Fri 02:00-04:00 PST. eng-ops, please own canary + rollback.

eng-ops: Got it. Plan: canary to 2 customers during Fri window, monitor 2 hours, then proceed to full cohort Monday if no regressions. Rollback hooks are in the runbook. Staging commands:
```
# install agent v2.14.0
curl -fsSL https://internal.pkg/redwood-agent/v2.14.0/install.sh | bash
# enable audit collection
redwood-agent config set audit_mode continuous
```

Priya S.: Note to Sales: do NOT promise SOC 2 status yet. Use this line if customers ask: "We're running a SOC 2 continuous audit pilot; we'll share attestation artifacts once the pilot completes."

Samir K.: Understood. I'll attach the prep checklist to customer invites. Will the Console show per-customer artifacts?

Caroline L.: Yes — Console > Security > Audits (beta) will show time-limited artifacts for pilot customers. We'll also generate a signed PDF attestation per customer at pilot close.

Ryan M. (Security): For air-gapped installs, evidence collection will produce an offline bundle that the customer uploads to our ingest endpoint or via SFTP. We'll provide clear instructions in the prep call. Minimal evidence: config snapshot, cert chain, agent heartbeat, KMS attestation blob, recent agent logs (7d).

Infra-Bot: PILOT CHECKLIST:
- infra: agent v2.14.0 deployed to staging + canary customers
- sec: token rotation and KMS attestation flow validated
- cs: NDA and data-consent collected for cohort
- product: Console beta enabled for pilot IDs
- eng-ops: rollback playbook and smoke tests ready

Elena P.: Please post status updates to #private-deployments-status. Proposed checkpoints: Fri after canary, Mon midday, Wed post-analysis.

Caroline L.: Owner matrix:
- Pilot lead: Caroline L.
- Security: Ryan M.
- Runtime/SRE: Elena P.
- Eng Ops: eng-ops
- Customer Success: Samir K.
- Sales comms: Priya S.

Samir K.: Can Caroline/Ryan drop the CS prep email + consent template by EOD? I'll send invites once those are ready.

Caroline L.: Will share templates: scope, data types collected, retention window (30 days for pilot artifacts), contact for questions.

eng-ops: I'll post the rollback checklist and the smoke-test script to the runbook and link it here when done.

Caroline L.: Thanks all 129 This is high visibility with enterprise customers and compliance. Tag me or Ryan immediately for legal/PKI/infra blockers. :sparkles:
